raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

In deterministic mode every unquantized Triton MoE call runs with one fixed config (`BLOCK_SIZE_M/N/K` 64/64/32, `GROUP_SIZE_M` 8), whatever the number of tokens, because the tuned per-M configs would make a token's result depend on its batch. On MI350X that config is slow for prefill: on Qwen3-30B-A3B the MoE is the largest cost in deterministic mode. This PR uses a faster config (128/128/64, `GROUP_SIZE_M` 1, 4 warps, 2 stages) above 64 tokens and keeps the current one below. The two configs give the same bits for every token, so the switch keeps deterministic mode batch-invariant, and outputs do not change. On MI350X, deterministic Qwen3-30B-A3B throughput is 8-12% higher (1k-32k input) with every determinism check passing, and DeepSeek-V2-Lite 6-9% higher. Only unquantized MoE on gfx950 changes.

## Modifications

- `fused_moe_triton_config.py`: deterministic mode's config moves into `_deterministic_config(M, dtype, is_marlin, block_shape)`. On gfx950, for unquantized MoE (`dtype is None`, no block shape, not Marlin), it returns `_DETERMINISTIC_CONFIG_GFX950_LARGE_M` above 64 tokens; everything else keeps `_DETERMINISTIC_CONFIG` (the current config).
- New CPU test `test/registered/unit/layers/moe/test_deterministic_moe_config.py`: the switch, the cases that keep one config (quantized dtypes, block-scaled, Marlin, other GPUs), and that callers get a copy.
- New gfx950 test `test/registered/amd/test_deterministic_moe_config_gfx950.py` (`stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x`): on three MoE shapes, bf16 and fp16, the two configs give bitwise identical outputs for 1,024 tokens, and rows of that batch equal the same rows computed on their own or in batches of 7-64 tokens with the small-M config.
- Unchanged: normal mode, NVIDIA, gfx942, quantized MoE.

## Accuracy Tests

MI350X, ROCm 7.2.4, `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.22-rocm724-mi35x-20261021`, deterministic mode (`--enable-deterministic-inference`, Triton prefill and AITER decode attention, together with the other open MI350X deterministic-mode PRs).

Kernel level (Qwen3-30B-A3B shape: 128 experts, top-8, hidden 2048, intermediate 768; DeepSeek-V2-Lite shape: 64 experts, top-6, hidden 2048, intermediate 1408; bf16): all 288 fixed configs in the sweep (BLOCK_M 16-128, BLOCK_N/K 32-128, GROUP 1/8, 4/8 warps, 1/2 stages) give results bitwise identical to the current config, and every row of a 16k-token batch equals the same row computed alone or in smaller batches. Against a float32 PyTorch reference, the current and the new config have the same error (cosine similarity 0.999991, max abs diff 0.0065 / 0.0095 at 64 / 4,096 tokens).

End to end, Qwen3-30B-A3B TP1, `python3 -m sglang.test.test_deterministic` (`single`, `prefix`, `prefix --return-logprob`, `radix_cache`, 50 trials) plus a bitwise batch-size check (the same prompt in batches of 1 to 50, 1,275 responses, token IDs and logprobs compared exactly with the batch-size-1 response; the batches cross the 64-token switch): `single` 1 output, `prefix` 1/1/1/1, prefix logprobs identical, radix cache consistent, bitwise 1,275 / 1,275. GSM8K (sgl-eval 0.1.2, temperature 0, 1,319 questions): 95.00%, unchanged (with this branch). Both new tests pass on MI350X (`9 passed`, including 6 subtests).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Kernel time per MoE call (bf16, MI350X), new config vs current, by number of tokens:

| tokens | 1 | 4 | 16 | 64 | 256 | 1,024 | 4,096 | 16,384 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B shape | 0.93x | 1.03x | 1.07x | 1.01x | 1.05x | 1.24x | 1.67x | 1.83x |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite shape | 0.94x | 1.07x | 1.04x | 1.03x | 1.11x | 1.38x | 1.69x | 1.91x |

(speed-up, higher is better; up to 64 tokens the PR keeps the current config, so those sizes are unchanged.)

End to end, deterministic mode, `python3 -m sglang.benchmark.serving --backend sglang --dataset-name random --random-range-ratio 1.0 --request-rate inf`, output throughput, main vs this PR (same server arguments, interleaved):

| model, TP | workload | main | this PR | change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B, 1 | 1k in / 1k out, 256 prompts | 7,452 tok/s | 8,104 tok/s | +8.7% (TTFT -27%) |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B, 1 | 8k in / 1k out, 256 prompts | 2,138 tok/s | 2,381 tok/s | +11.4% (TTFT -22%) |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B, 1 | 32k in / 256 out, 64 prompts | 172.0 tok/s | 193.3 tok/s | +12.4% (TTFT -14%) |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B, 1 | 1k in / 256 out, concurrency 1 | 163.7 tok/s | 164.3 tok/s | +0.4% |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B, 1 | 1k in / 256 out, concurrency 16 | 1,278 tok/s | 1,310 tok/s | +2.4% (TTFT -24%) |

(1k row: mean of two rounds, which agree within 0.3%; other rows one round.) The same config above 64 tokens, applied through a local switch, also gave on DeepSeek-V2-Lite TP1 +8.9% at 1k in / 1k out and +6.0% at 8k in / 1k out, and on Qwen3-30B-A3B TP1 at 64k / 120k input (YaRN) +7.7% / +5.5%. Normal mode is unchanged.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -10,10 +10,11 @@
 import triton
 
 from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_exec
-from sglang.srt.utils import get_device_name, is_hip
+from sglang.srt.utils import get_device_name, is_gfx95_supported, is_hip
 
 logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 _is_hip = is_hip()
+_is_gfx95 = _is_hip and is_gfx95_supported()
 _LOW_SMEM_FP8_DEFAULT_CUTOFF_BYTES = 128 * 1024
 
 
@@ -177,6 +178,45 @@ def get_moe_configs(
     return None
 
 
+# Deterministic mode cannot pick a config by M from tuned files, since a token's
+# result must not depend on how many tokens share its batch.
+_DETERMINISTIC_CONFIG = {
+    "BLOCK_SIZE_M": 64,
+    "BLOCK_SIZE_N": 64,
+    "BLOCK_SIZE_K": 32,
+    "GROUP_SIZE_M": 8,
+}
+# Measured on MI350X for bf16 MoE (E = 64-128, top-k 6-8): 1.7-1.9x faster than
+# _DETERMINISTIC_CONFIG at 4k-16k tokens, but ~3% slower at a few tokens. It gives
+# the same bits as _DETERMINISTIC_CONFIG, which is what makes switching by M safe.
+_DETERMINISTIC_CONFIG_GFX950_LARGE_M = {
+    "BLOCK_SIZE_M": 128,
+    "BLOCK_SIZE_N": 128,
+    "BLOCK_SIZE_K": 64,
+    "GROUP_SIZE_M": 1,
+    "num_warps": 4,
+    "num_stages": 2,
+}
+_DETERMINISTIC_GFX950_SMALL_M = 64
+
+
+def _deterministic_config(
+    M: int,
+    dtype: Optional[str],
+    is_marlin: bool,
+    block_shape: Optional[List[int]],
+) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    if (
+        _is_gfx95
+        and dtype is None
+        and block_shape is None
+        and not is_marlin
+        and M > _DETERMINISTIC_GFX950_SMALL_M
+    ):
+        return dict(_DETERMINISTIC_CONFIG_GFX950_LARGE_M)
+    return dict(_DETERMINISTIC_CONFIG)
+
+
 def get_default_config(
     M: int,
     E: int,

     block_shape: Optional[List[int]] = None,
 ) -> Dict[str, int]:
     if get_exec().deterministic.enable_deterministic_inference:
-        config = {
-            "BLOCK_SIZE_M": 64,
-            "BLOCK_SIZE_N": 64,
-            "BLOCK_SIZE_K": 32,
-            "GROUP_SIZE_M": 8,
-        }
-        return config
+        return _deterministic_config(M, dtype, is_marlin, block_shape)
     if dtype == "fp8_w8a8":
         if block_shape is None:
             if _use_low_smem_fp8_default():

@@ -0,0 +1,103 @@
+"""Deterministic mode on gfx950 runs unquantized MoE through one Triton config up to
+_DETERMINISTIC_GFX950_SMALL_M tokens and a faster one above. That keeps a token's
+result independent of its batch only if both configs give the same bits, so check
+exactly that: the same tokens through both configs, and the rows of a large batch
+(large-M config) against the same rows computed in small batches (small-M config).
+"""
+
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx95_supported
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import publish_build_topology
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=60, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not torch.cuda.is_available() or not is_gfx95_supported(), reason="needs gfx950"
+)
+
+# (experts, top-k, hidden, intermediate per expert): Qwen3-30B-A3B and DeepSeek-V2-Lite at TP1,
+# and a narrower expert.
+SHAPES = [(128, 8, 2048, 768), (64, 6, 2048, 1408), (32, 4, 1024, 512)]
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module", autouse=True)
+def _runtime_scaffolding():
+    """`fused_experts` needs global server args and a TP group (single rank, gloo)."""
+    import os
+
+    from sglang.srt.distributed.parallel_state import (
+        init_distributed_environment,
+        initialize_model_parallel,
+        model_parallel_is_initialized,
+    )
+    from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs, set_global_server_args_for_scheduler
+
+    set_global_server_args_for_scheduler(ServerArgs(model_path="dummy"))
+    os.environ.setdefault("MASTER_ADDR", "127.0.0.1")
+    os.environ.setdefault("MASTER_PORT", "29642")
+    os.environ.setdefault("RANK", "0")
+    os.environ.setdefault("WORLD_SIZE", "1")
+    os.environ.setdefault("LOCAL_RANK", "0")
+    if not torch.distributed.is_initialized():
+        init_distributed_environment(world_size=1, rank=0, local_rank=0, backend="gloo")
+    if not model_parallel_is_initialized():
+        publish_build_topology(tp_size=1, ep_size=1, pp_size=1)
+        initialize_model_parallel(backend="gloo")
+
+
+def _moe(x, w1, w2, topk_weights, topk_ids, config):
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe.moe_runner.triton_utils import override_config
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe.moe_runner.triton_utils.fused_moe import fused_moe
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe.topk import StandardTopKOutput
+
+    out = StandardTopKOutput(topk_weights, topk_ids, None)
+    with override_config(config):
+        # fused_moe may write its output into its input.
+        return fused_moe(x.clone(), w1, w2, out)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.bfloat16, torch.float16])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("experts,topk,hidden,inter", SHAPES)
+def test_small_and_large_m_configs_give_the_same_bits(
+    dtype, experts, topk, hidden, inter
+):
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe.moe_runner.triton_utils import (
+        fused_moe_triton_config as cfg,
+    )
+
+    small_cfg = cfg._DETERMINISTIC_CONFIG
+    large_cfg = cfg._DETERMINISTIC_CONFIG_GFX950_LARGE_M
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(experts * hidden + inter)
+    w1 = (
+        (torch.randn(experts, 2 * inter, hidden, generator=g) / hidden**0.5)
+        .to(dtype)
+        .cuda()
+    )
+    w2 = (
+        (torch.randn(experts, hidden, inter, generator=g) / inter**0.5).to(dtype).cuda()
+    )
+    m = 1024
+    x = torch.randn(m, hidden, generator=g).to(dtype).cuda()
+    weights, ids = torch.topk(
+        torch.softmax(torch.randn(m, experts, generator=g), -1), topk, dim=-1
+    )
+    weights = (weights / weights.sum(-1, keepdim=True)).float().cuda()
+    ids = ids.to(torch.int32).cuda()
+
+    full_large = _moe(x, w1, w2, weights, ids, large_cfg)
+    assert torch.equal(full_large, _moe(x, w1, w2, weights, ids, small_cfg))
+    # Rows of the large batch against the same rows on their own or in small batches, as a
+    # server would run them below the switch.
+    for start, n in ((0, 1), (5, 7), (100, 64), (999, 25)):
+        rows = slice(start, start + n)
+        part = _moe(x[rows], w1, w2, weights[rows], ids[rows], small_cfg)
+        assert torch.equal(part, full_large[rows]), f"rows {start}:{start + n}"
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))

@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.moe_runner.triton_utils import fused_moe_triton_config as cfg
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestDeterministicMoeConfig(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_gfx950_bf16_switches_above_small_m(self):
+        with patch.object(cfg, "_is_gfx95", True):
+            small = cfg._deterministic_config(
+                cfg._DETERMINISTIC_GFX950_SMALL_M, None, False, None
+            )
+            large = cfg._deterministic_config(
+                cfg._DETERMINISTIC_GFX950_SMALL_M + 1, None, False, None
+            )
+        self.assertEqual(small, cfg._DETERMINISTIC_CONFIG)
+        self.assertEqual(large, cfg._DETERMINISTIC_CONFIG_GFX950_LARGE_M)
+
+    def test_quantized_and_other_gpus_keep_one_config(self):
+        """Only unquantized MoE on gfx950 was shown to give the same bits with both configs."""
+        cases = [
+            (True, "fp8_w8a8", False, None),
+            (True, "fp8_w8a8", False, [128, 128]),
+            (True, "int8_w8a16", False, None),
+            (True, None, True, None),
+            (True, None, False, [128, 128]),
+            (False, None, False, None),
+        ]
+        for is_gfx95, dtype, is_marlin, block_shape in cases:
+            with self.subTest(
+                is_gfx95=is_gfx95,
+                dtype=dtype,
+                is_marlin=is_marlin,
+                block_shape=block_shape,
+            ):
+                with patch.object(cfg, "_is_gfx95", is_gfx95):
+                    for m in (1, 64, 65, 16384):
+                        self.assertEqual(
+                            cfg._deterministic_config(m, dtype, is_marlin, block_shape),
+                            cfg._DETERMINISTIC_CONFIG,
+                        )
+
+    def test_returned_config_is_a_copy(self):
+        """Callers pop keys from the config; the module constants must not change."""
+        with patch.object(cfg, "_is_gfx95", True):
+            c = cfg._deterministic_config(4096, None, False, None)
+        c.pop("BLOCK_SIZE_M")
+        self.assertIn("BLOCK_SIZE_M", cfg._DETERMINISTIC_CONFIG_GFX950_LARGE_M)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
